issues.on_page: Business-type Charges for Services 1,036,200 = Sales 1,008,036 + Other revenue 28,164 (p7)
issues.issue: The Statement of Activities (p2) counts the utility 'Other revenue' 28,164 in Charges for Services. Under the user ruling of 2026-11-06 it should be charges for services (Utility Charges), not other. The older 2026-10-23 category_decision is superseded.
issues.resolved: 2026-11-09: category set to charges for services/fees (Statement of Activities counts it in Charges for Services)

issues.on_page: Grant income 2,000 (Sewer); p2 shows it only as Operating Grants and Contributions
issues.issue: The report doesn't say who gave the grant, so 'federal grants' is an assumption. Albion_FY2023 records the same kind of line as intergovernmental/state aid.

issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 1,700,616; County treasurer cash 18,116 (Total Governmental Funds)
issues.issue: Governmental cash is printed on the governmental funds balance sheet but ending_cash is null, while ending_investments (1,065,073) was taken from the same page. Under the 2026-11-06 ruling, cash is filled wherever it is printed.
This is a cost-type line, but its category 'utilities' is the same as the function name. A cost-type name such as 'Utilities (Power, Gas, Phone)' may be intended.

issues.on_page: Cemetery department 46,591; statement Public works 68,554 = Street Lighting 21,963 + Cemetery 46,591 (p5)
issues.issue: The Cemetery department lines (detail[40]-detail[44]) are categorized health/welfare, but the governmental funds statement counts Cemetery under Public works (streets/highways). So the detail's function split doesn't tie to the statement's functions. The category is defensible.
